summary.text: David Richardson is the Republican candidate for Arizona House of Representatives District 12 (2 seats) in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the Republican primary on July 21, 2026.
According to Ballotpedia, he is an executive and inventor with experience in defense, research and development, and the bioscience industry.

paragraphs.text: David Richardson was born in Arizona and earned a bachelor's degree in 2012 and a graduate degree in 2013, both from Arizona State University, according to Ballotpedia.

His career experience includes working as an executive and inventor, with professional experience in defense and R&D technical and engineering roles and executive leadership in the bioscience industry.

Ballotpedia lists his affiliations as the National Small Business Association's Leadership Council, the Engineering Advisory Board at Grand Canyon University, a U.S. State Department Global Innovation Fellowship, the Flinn Foundation as a bioscience entrepreneur, and the Biomarker Council of the International Cancer Advocacy Network.
